sections.overview: Platynematichthys notatus is a freshwater catfish in the South American family Pimelodidae.
sections.identification: It is a demersal member of the long-whiskered catfish family; its genus name refers to flattened barbels.
sections.habitat: It is recorded from the Amazon and Orinoco river basins.
